method.actual_length_definition: geodesic length of saved route polyline; not a surveyed pedestrian travel distance
method.union: category buffers unioned; each traversed route segment measured independently
method.unknown: null means not measured/unverified; zero only means zero matching records/geometric proximity

healthcare_facilities.interpretation: Sensitivity scenario for flagged pairs only; not bounds on true physical facilities.

police_stations.interpretation: Sensitivity scenario for flagged pairs only; not bounds on true physical facilities.

shops_and_businesses.interpretation: Sensitivity scenario for flagged pairs only; not bounds on true physical facilities.

evidence_confidence.scope: Evidence completeness, never personal safety or calibrated probability

routes.overlap_rule: Category memberships and proximity percentages overlap. Do not sum them. Unknown-tag road proximity may overlap yes/no-tag road proximity.

sidewalk.interpretation: Any usable sidewalk-family value is tag availability only; no inferred sidewalk presence, side, continuity or walkability.
